notes: This is the formal response-space envelope for the 1M MARS56 S4P campaign.
Adaptive acquisition must target sparse Lp/Ls/Q/|K| bins inside these fixed physical ranges, not only the observed pilot-data min/max range.
The per-bin target is ceil(100000 / 4^4) = 391 so each 100k checkpoint is guided toward uniform 4D physical-feature occupancy, not merely one-sample coverage.
Uniformity acceptance is still measured from real EMX-derived labels at each 100k checkpoint.
